items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: Dr. Locke should retract every statement he uttered in his book, because none of it is true.

ctx.x: But when you could know manners.

Oh, yes. Different. But I'll say this much for them, they were great fellows. Now, all those men that were down there that established historical things in music. Somebody up here at Howard University or a Ninnicka poop around New York or a denounce it. No, no. I don't like that at all. Dr. Locke should retract every statement he uttered in his book, because none of it is true. I've told you about the band in Savannah. I've told you about the musicians down in Florida. I've told you about them in Pensacola, North…
I'm quite sure he died a couple years or more. Anyhow, he put out a little book. Yes.
